summary.text: Tara Murray is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 104 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Terri Violet (R).
She is a teacher in the Ritenour School District.

paragraphs.text: Tara Murray was born in St. Louis and, according to Ballotpedia, graduated from Ritenour High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Northeast Missouri State University in 1993 and a graduate degree from Truman State University in 1995.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has taught middle school in the Ritenour School District for almost 30 years and has served as an NEA union representative for 25 years.
Murray ran for the same seat in 2024, when Terri Violet won the general election.
In the 2024 survey, she said she would work to ensure public money goes to public schools and to expand universal programs to include early childhood education.
